steps.content: The ginger girl suddenly breaks through a crack above them, crashing into the ground. She is quickly engulfed by the turbulent Mania of this space.
She stands in front of Coquelic, blocking Shalom, panting heavily, seemingly still recovering from the collision.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Stop, Coquelic! This isn't a fight, she's about to swallow you whole!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You're still alive... Are you here to get in my way?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I... I snuck in while you were causing chaos, watching you guys fight, but I couldn't intervene. Until you suddenly... pierced her, made her bloom. Then everything went wrong.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: This isn't reality. In reality, the flowers she bloomed have already blocked the entire space. Just now, they suddenly started backfiring on you. And when I came in, I understood.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You're being controlled. These white lights have entangled you. The more you attack her, the more the white light will swallow you. You'll be brainwashed. Stop now!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...So you recklessly dove into the flower that swallows people and followed me in here... all to save me? Hahaha!
Coquelic bursts into laughter, her disgust palpable.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Save me? Who are you trying to fool?! I'm feeling great right now, never felt better! I'll kill her soon, and you're here to save her! Even though she's blown you up with her own hands!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You're the one being brainwashed!
Her words are merciless, like a knife piercing the already trembling young detective. She struggles to keep her footing, teeth gritted as she holds on amidst the rampaging Mania.
This is terrifying, beyond anything she's ever faced before. It takes all her strength just to stay on this horrifying battlefield that far exceeds her capacity.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: No... I... I'm here for myself... for my own...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You don't even have the courage to look back at her!

The ginger fool in front of her is already covered in wounds, her heart shattered. For some reason, decades of memories flood back, looking at her feels like seeing every broken person who first entered the Garden, like seeing her old self.
This girl didn't shed a single tear while being tortured. What is she doing now?

Does she think she'll be treated gently if she makes a sad face? Does she think she can escape by begging for mercy? It's because she can't do anything herself that she blindly believes in other people's kindness! And then she gets trampled on!
Coquelic's head throbs as strange images flash through her mind.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: No, don't be blinded by vengeance, she loves it when you're like this... she wants to fan other people's hatred.
So what are you trying to say? That I should let go? That I should forgive her, embrace love and peace?
Talk about love and peace with her and this damn world?! Does the fate expect us to hope for justice after pushing us into the abyss?
Now that things have come to this, I'll handle it myself... even if it means death, I...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I know what you've lost is irreplaceable, you're capable of making everyone pay, you don't believe in any justice, only revenge can heal you.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But none of this should be taken for granted, because from the beginning, you shouldn't have been subjected to this deprivation. There's no reason for you to endure such suffering.
Christina bites her lip, holding back tears as she looks up at Coquelic. She can't run away, a step back would mean falling into an abyss.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Coquelic, wake up. The Garden is still alive.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Only you can save them.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Things didn't add up at the scene, but you were too hurt to see the truth. I brought it to you.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: The scene was fabricated? The people in the Garden weren't killed? Where's the evidence?

That large pool of blood, it would have taken at least 20 minutes to clot, but the petals that fell on it didn't have a single drop of blood on them. This proves that a lot of time passed after the bleeding before the vase was shattered.

Not just there, all the damaged scenes had the same unnatural feeling to some extent. The bleeding should have occurred with the battle's destruction, but there are too many places where the traces don't match.

Although it could be explained by coincidence, but... isn't there another possibility? The high-intensity attack by HUSH was real, and the Garden was destroyed. But the death and brutality were faked.
It's also possible that the so-called "slaughter" never happened.
The mastermind was her. The wisest, the most efficient. She never wastes energy on useless work. There must be a reason...

The entire ordeal was designed to provoke Coquelic who was at the scene. She cherished the Garden so much; faced with such a shocking sight, she couldn't muster the strength to look closely at such a brutal scene. She would immediately find her enemy and fight to the death.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: But why would she do this?
Why... Christina has some guesses, but right now she needs to prove...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Thistle, you work for the Garden, so you must have a lot of connections. I need you to do something for me. Get the real evidence, prove my hypothesis!
Christina reaches determinedly into her pocket, intending to take out her phone and play Thistle's recorded call. Unfortunately, this spiritual space seems to have forgotten to bring her phone in.
She pretends to be calm as she withdraws her hand and wipes it. Coquelic's gaze is fixed on her, giving Christina confidence.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The evidence is with Thistle. We collected the coagulated blood from the scene and had it verified at a clinic. It's definitely mixed with a large amount of <color=#fb9259>artificial blood</color>.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: My hypothesis is correct. HUSH faked the scene, making you believe that the Garden was dead. She always pursues efficiency and economy, such a roundabout way can only be to satisfy two goals: <color=#fb9259>she needs the Garden alive, and at the same time, to drive you mad.</color>
Coquelic tries to follow this line of thought, but the white light still surrounds her, warning her not to be gullible, and to think clearly about her true purpose.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...I don't believe what you're saying. I won't let you lead me on, don't think you can fool me!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You, a person who's been blinded by her, a waste who gets weak-kneed at the sight of death, what could you find in a place like that?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: If they're still alive, why didn't that woman from Paradeisos say so earlier? Wouldn't that have been a better way to trick me into helping her?!
Christina opens her mouth to tell her something, but the words suddenly get stuck in her throat. She feels a pang of pain.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: Is facing the truth that hard for you, detective?!
It's very hard... Mireya... very hard...
But... we must face it. Because justice can only come from truth.
Even if the truth is painful.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I've looked into Rahu's transfer records. She was affiliated with the FAC before July, N.F. 103, participating in the Eclipse Operation. Around the time of the Erica Villa incident, her demeanor drastically changed. I contacted her previous commander in the FAC, Captain Conrad, and learned a lot of things.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: From the medical records at that time, Rahu suffered a fatal injury in the early morning of July 24, similar to what I encountered... It was the Hush's Schorl. It can be inferred that they may have fought, the Hush killed Rahu, then saved her and changed her.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I've seen this situation before.
Christina stops, aware of the gaze behind her. In the silence, she can even imagine that smile, the one she used to love so much.
She clenches her teeth and, word by word, musters all her strength to say what needs to be said.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: In <color=#fb9259>N.F. 104</color>, I attacked Nirvana, attacked Shalom, the Hush on the scene at the time, with the utmost hatred. I was also severely injured then, I wanted to kill her, and then... I was changed too.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I always thought... always thought it was because she redeemed me. But, but, maybe that's not the case. Seeing what you look like now, I'm even more certain, the truth is not like that.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The Hush can control the Sinner under <color=#fb9259>certain conditions</color>, making them completely serve herself. This is a more economical, efficient, and stable method than killing them. This is the tactic I know the smartest and most powerful <color=#fb9259>Shalom</color> would use.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: This is the true intention of destroying the Garden. She wants to incite your anger for revenge, and then, like now, use her abilities to completely control you. As for the lives of others... she can "economize," even make them serve her, can't she?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I have some clues about the whereabouts of the Garden. Once we reach a safe place, I'll tell you. But first, you have to wake up. You also have to see the truth. The truth is—
Christina stammers, her mouth opening and closing several times without being able to utter a word. The tears come first.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The people I loved most, the things I believed in most, are all gone... It hurts me too! But I can't just stand still, can I?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Unlike you, revenge doesn't heal me. Even if I exterminate all my enemies, it's just forcing me to admit that the world is rotten, forcing me to stab myself, and then turning me into the person I hate the most.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Laugh at me if you want, but I choose to believe in justice forever. No matter what happens, I refuse to accept that the world is inherently bad. I cannot stand by while people are stripped of their rights as if it's the norm, or while wrongdoers behave as if their actions are normal.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I only agree with one thing you said, that I should get up on my own, only I can save myself... I will prove that justice exists, and then bring it to those who need it. Only in this way, can my heart heal.
She lifts her head again, her eyes still tearful, but her gaze is no longer wavering. It's so sharp that it makes Coquelic shiver.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I found the truth, and brought it to you. I don't have the ability to execute justice, so you do it.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Don't you want to be free from fate and hold it in your hand? Then stop it before it destroys you, don't give it the chance to trample on you, don't let it take away what's important to you.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Even if you don't believe others and don't listen to big words, you should at least look at your own heart.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Don't you want them to come back?
...Of course I do.
The moment she realizes this, the intense desire that she can no longer suppress breaks through all the resentment in her heart.
To hell with the enemy, to hell with revenge, who cares about those dirty bugs? Coquelic just wants to return to her Garden immediately, wants to see her flowers in their vibrant state and hug them.

At this moment, the light that has been entangling her is repelled, and the vitality and resentment that had been instilled in her body are abruptly cut off. And Coquelic fully recovers herself, her consciousness gradually clearing, and the feeling of languor in her body completely disappears.
It isn't until this moment that she sees the exit to leave this place is not far away.
She looks at Shalom. From beginning to end, this woman hasn't said a word, neither refuting nor admitting. At some point, her powerless body had been pierced by blue light spikes, unable to move.
But she doesn't have a trace of a painful expression, she just looks at Christina, as if pondering something. After a long time, realizing Coquelic's gaze, she smiles.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...What's all this about? Are you playing me? Does it mean anything to provoke me like this?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Using my ability is quite troublesome. Without adequate preparation, I dare not face a strong adversary like you directly. I didn't know how far I should go, I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: They are all good flowers, rather than being broken, it's better to fall into my hands, as an alternative... Heh, I'm just kidding, of course, you are still the best.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What, you want to control me again? What method will you use this time?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: No need, I've done what I needed to do, I don't need to push you around anymore. You've broken this <color=#fb9259>Rule</color>, escaped my <color=#fb9259>emotions</color>, and became free.
The space on this side vibrates as if it's trembling in terror, Shalom watches the blue light spikes condense. There's not much time, but it's enough.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Now, run for your life.

She says calmly. As her voice fades, a startling roar erupts from the rift torn open by Coquelic herself. A monstrous giant claw crashes through the crack. Then, a massive demon squeezes out of the rift, roaring.

Giant blue light pierces through its body, triangular patterns of light are imprinted all over it, producing waves of white smoke. It's not a physical entity, but the embodiment of intense emotions. Like a violent storm, it roars and screams. Pierced by countless sharp nails, choking its throat, it still struggles to tear everything apart.
Christina is nearly nauseated by the sudden onslaught of Mania. But beneath the distorted, monstrous, and terrifying appearance of this creature, she recognizes a familiar feeling.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You are... Shalom?

With each roar it emits, it triggers violent vibrations within Coquelic. Not out of fear, but because all the Mania within her is ignited, fueling an uncontrollable urge to cry out in harmony; to resist, to shatter everything that binds her.
Is it that she's being "controlled" by it? Or has a part of her soul "resonated" with it? Has she become one with it?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Paradeisos separated my emotions and sent them to the other side of the rift. This way, the purely rational me can stay on the front line, while the emotional side dives into Mania, observing the changes in the world and human hearts for them.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I see... so these are the feelings you were exiled with by Paradeisos... this is your heart...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You can't control all of Mania, you can only control one side of human hearts through "this," only control the emotions that are the same as yours... This is your true ability.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: And to provoke me, you even manipulated Paradeisos's orders. What you did to me...
She wants to continue, but sees Shalom raise her hand in a smile, her index finger lightly touching her lips.
Shhh... she silently says to Coquelic.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's not hatred, it's the power we were born with... Saying it out loud would make it ineffective.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Your life has only been partially restored. Use it sparingly, Coquelic.
Coquelic understands. She looks at Shalom, then at the "monster" behind her, shackled layer upon layer, and for the first time, she smiles at ease.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It screams so miserably, don't you feel sorry for it?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: No. The separation technique is perfect, it's been long since I've felt anything.
She looks up at the crumbling space. Countless blue light spikes coalesce from the void and pierce the giant beast's body, also piercing Shalom. She's used to it, not bothered in the slightest.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I can only go this far now. After you go out, remember, that matter is very important to me.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Heh... forget it. I can't manage what you really think, thanks to you I can't even take care of myself.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I won't accept your request, you go ahead and do your best, Shalom.

What answers Coquelic is the roar of the beast. Its claws tear through all the shackles in the void, facing the countless blue lights piercing it, demolishing the prison that has confined it for many years.

Shalom watches as the grand hall gradually collapses, as the Mania on the other side swarm in, as the holy Rules finally decay. This is her power, not imprisoned, not distorted, not deprived, her true heart. She took it back with "rationality".
Everything is arranged and everything is going as planned. Whatever follows is her own: her first or the last battlefield.

Coquelic shuts her eyes, emotionally distancing herself. "This isn't my concern," she thinks, "Time to move on." With a swift motion, she yanks Christina—who is on the verge of being consumed by Mania—to her side. She forcefully draws a new floral sword from within herself, its blade blooming with radiant crystal flowers.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Kid, I'm getting you out of here. Once we're out, lead me straight to them! Hesitate for even a second, and I'll dismember you. Dare to lie to me, and I'll make sure the entire world goes down with you. Mark my words.
